name: Creamy Mushroom and Spinach Pork Chops (Skillet)
why: Verified published nutrition 465 cal / 8g carbs / 47g protein per serving over 6 servings - dead center of the 400-650 cal, <=35g carb band. Whole-muscle pork chops pan-seared then simmered in a mushroom-spinach-parmesan cream gravy: meat + fat + non-starchy veg, no rice/potato/pasta base, so structurally low-carb and it batches cleanly to 14 in a skillet with weigh-and-divide portioning. Distinct from existing creamy-mushroom-pork-chops-over-mashed-potatoes (that one is over potatoes, high carb) and this run's already-accepted creamy-garlic-herb-wine-pork-chops (wine/herb, no mushroom+spinach). Every main ingredient has a board home; no unmapped flags.
